assumptions: USD million, thousand appointments. Fictional Sage Harbor Clinic. Toy allocate clinic room-hours under mandatory follow-up commitments, then maximize contribution. No quality or medical ranking implied; only hypothetical finance model.

evidence.text: [Services] New consultation N earns $160, variable cost $70, room time .5h. Routine follow-up F earns $90, variable cost $40, time .25h. Demand caps N 30k, F 40k. Fixed annual room expense 2m unchanged.
[Constraint] 16k room-hours available. Contract requires at least 20k F appointments. Appointments divisible for planning; no staffing shortage outside room-hours.
[Expansion] Additional 4k room-hours available for .65m fixed cost; no other expense.

[Telehealth] Alternative to expansion: up to 8k F shifted to virtual, same consideration, cost $30/appointment, no room time. One-time platform cost .25m. Virtual slots count toward F demand and minimum; cannot combine alternatives.
[Quality] All scheduling alternatives assumed clinically appropriate in this toy; no patient outcomes or acuity data provided.
[Memo] Manager ranks N by margin/appointment and recommends expansion without considering virtual shift.

qas.question: Contribution trên room-hour của follow-up F so với N?
Base optimal plan nếu F cap 40k dùng 10k room-hours, còn bao nhiêu N appointments?
Base operating contribution sau fixed room expense?
Net incremental contribution nếu thuê thêm 4k room-hours?
Virtual shift 8k F tạo bao nhiêu incremental profit so base?
qas.answer: Save $10 mỗi F=0,08m; giải phóng 2k giờ cho 4k N=0,36m; trừ platform .25m, net .19m.

qas.question: Nên chọn phương án nào theo mục tiêu finance trong case?
qas.answer: Virtual shift cho incremental .19m, hơn expansion .07m và base zero. Không phải khuyến nghị triage thực tế.

qas.question: Tại sao không đánh giá dịch vụ theo margin/appointment riêng?
qas.answer: Room-hour là bottleneck; F đóng góp nhiều hơn mỗi giờ, và minimum contractual phải được giữ.

qas.question: Có thể kết luận chuyển mọi follow-up sang virtual an toàn y khoa?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ giả định 8k clinically appropriate; không có outcomes hay acuity, không dùng bài toán tài chính làm clinical decision.

assumptions: USD million; thousand km. Fictional Birch Route. Toy four-year equivalent annual comparison, annual lease payments include vehicle capital cost. No residual or tax, identical carrying capacity.

evidence.text: [Diesel fleet] Annual distance 2,000k km. Diesel fuel .30$/km; maintenance .15$/km; vehicle lease .65m/year. No other differential costs.
[EV fleet] Same distance; electricity .12$/km, maintenance .09$/km; vehicle lease .95m/year. Charging infrastructure annualized cost .18m. Upfront depot upgrade .8m separately required, budget .6m.

[Grant] Grant .25m approved and paid upfront only for EV depot upgrade, reducing net initial requirement. Do not annualize upfront amount in annual cost calculation because board evaluates capital budget separately.
[Stress] Electricity cost per km rises to $.22, diesel unchanged. No range issues in stated scenarios.
[Board] Must meet net upfront budget; among qualifying options minimize base annual cost, also disclose stress outcome. Diesel renewal upfront zero.
[Memo] Analyst compares electricity and fuel only, ignores lease and charger costs.

qas.question: Annual diesel total cost theo specified annual cost model?
Annual EV base total cost?
Net upfront EV depot upgrade sau grant?
EV annual cost under stress electricity $.22/km?
Break-even electricity cost per km với diesel annual cost?
Có khẳng định EV có annual cost thấp hơn diesel ở base?
qas.answer: Không. Hai option bằng nhau 1,55m; EV cần .55m upfront, stress đắt hơn .2m. Rule không quy định tie-break.

qas.question: Vì sao khoản grant không được trừ lặp vào annual expense?
qas.answer: Grant paid one time để giảm initial cash; không phải annual fuel saving.

qas.question: Có so sánh lifecycle emissions và total climate benefit?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu electricity mix, battery manufacturing, fuel emissions và disposal assumptions.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Copper Mist Mobile. Toy auction decision based on incremental present value before license price. Upfront network capex, yearly net cash flows and terminal cleanup; discount factors provided.

evidence.text: [Incremental plan] Spectrum adds annual service receipts 50m and annual operating cash costs 30m for five years; no ramp. Upfront network rollout 35m; end year5 decommission cash cost 5m.
[Discount] 5-year annuity factor 3.604776, year5 discount factor .567427. License paid upfront; zero residual after year5, no tax.
[Financing limit] Maximum total upfront cash available 90m, including rollout and auction fee. No new debt in toy.
[Auction] Current winning threshold estimate 42m, not binding; bid must be integer million increments. Board requires nonnegative NPV and capex budget.
[Alternative] Network sharing if auction lost: upfront 10m, annual net cash 9m for five years, no terminal cleanup. Same factors. Cannot do both.
[Memo] CFO bids PV of gross receipts without operating or rollout costs; analyst says auction price must exceed competitor's estimate.

qas.question: PV incremental annual cash flow từ spectrum trước upfront và cleanup?
Economic break-even auction license fee?
Maximum license fee theo cash budget riêng?
Maximum integer bid under both constraints, ignoring sharing alternative opportunity cost?
qas.answer: 34 triệu USD. Economic NPV ceiling 34,258385 thấp hơn cash ceiling55.

qas.question: NPV tại estimated winning bid 42?
NPV network sharing alternative?
Nếu sharing có thể chọn thay spectrum, có đủ dùng ceiling34 để tối đa giá trị?
qas.answer: Không. So NPV spectrum với sharing: fee phải ≤34,258385−22,442984≈11,8154 để spectrum ít nhất ngang sharing. Ceiling34 chỉ test NPV≥0.

qas.question: Có xác định final auction clearing price chắc chắn?
qas.answer: Không. 42 là estimate, không phải outcome; thiếu bidder behavior.

assumptions: USD million; thousand seats and flight hours. Fictional Alder Jet. Toy choose route packages whole, aircraft time limited, contribution after all differential operating costs. Common aircraft ownership cost unchanged.

evidence.text: [Route A] Annual package earns 70m revenue; variable flight cost 50m; station fixed avoidable cost 4m; consumes 3k aircraft hours. Must operate A due network contract.
[Route B] Revenue 60m, flight cost 38m, station avoidable cost 5m; consumes 4k hours.
[Route C] Revenue 45m, flight cost 30m, station avoidable cost 3m; consumes 2k hours.
[Capacity] Aircraft hours 7k/year; routes cannot be partially operated; no transfer between routes. Choose A plus B or C or both only if capacity permits.
[Expansion] Wet-lease package adds 2k hours for 8m annual cost, enabling all three routes. Common ownership cost 12m unchanged. No other incremental cost.
[Memo] Route planning ranks B by revenue only and subtracts allocated ownership cost as if avoidable.

qas.question: Incremental contribution route A sau station cost?
Contribution B theo aircraft-hour, USD/hour?
Contribution C theo aircraft-hour?
Best feasible base contribution trước common ownership cost?
qas.answer: A+B uses 7k hours, contribution16+17=33m. A+C only28m despite higher C per-hour.

qas.question: Profit sau common ownership cost nếu wet-lease và chạy cả ba?
Incremental benefit wet-lease so optimal base?
Vì sao ranking contribution/hour không tự động chọn optimal route packages?
qas.answer: Packages indivisible và A mandatory; C dùng ít giờ nhưng phần giờ dư không đủ chạy B. Phải xét feasible combinations.

qas.question: Có tính network spillover của route C lên bookings A/B?
qas.answer: Không. Chưa có connecting passenger, demand interaction hoặc fare data.

assumptions: USD million; thousand hectares and million cubic meters. Fictional Clover Vale farm. Toy continuous hectares, annual water cap, contract minimum crop B; compare contribution after water charges included in variable cost.

evidence.text: [Crop A] Yield 5t/ha, price $400/t, nonwater variable cost $1,000/ha; water 4,000m³/ha, water charge $.10/m³. Demand cap 2k hectares equivalent.
[Crop B] Yield 8t/ha, price $250/t, nonwater variable $1,100/ha; water 2,000m³/ha at same charge. Demand cap 3k ha; mandatory at least 1k ha.
[Land] 4k hectares available; water cap 10m m³. Unused land zero incremental contribution. Common fixed expense .5m unchanged.
[Alternative] Drip irrigation for A only reduces water/ha by 25%, yield unchanged; annual extra maintenance $.1m, upfront .4m not included annual margin. No changes to nonwater cost.
[Policy] Maximize annual operating contribution under both land and water limits. Compare with/without drip and note upfront separately.
[Memo] Owner ranks crops by yield tonnes/ha and assumes all land can be planted with B despite demand cap.

qas.question: Contribution A mỗi ha sau water charge?
Contribution B mỗi ha sau water?
qas.answer: Contribution B = 8×250−1.100−2.000×0,10 = 700 USD/ha. Dùng mức giá nước chung 0,10 USD/m³ từ A.

qas.question: Optimal base hectares allocation và contribution trước fixed?
qas.answer: B 3k dùng6m nước; A 1k dùng4m, land4k. Contribution=3×700/1000+1×600/1000=2,7m.

qas.question: Drip A contribution mỗi ha trước extra maintenance?
Maximum annual contribution after extra drip maintenance and common fixed?
qas.answer: A and B both $700/ha; 4k feasible e.g. A1k B3k. 2,8−.1−.5=2,2m.

qas.question: Drip có cải thiện annual operating result ở assumptions base?
qas.answer: Không. Base=2,7−.5=2,2m; drip cũng 2,2m trước upfront .4m. Có water saving nhưng không tăng annual profit theo case.

qas.question: Vì sao yield cao của B không đủ để kết luận chọn hết B?
qas.answer: Need price, variable/water costs, land/water limits, B cap3k và minimum. Yield vật lý không phải contribution.

qas.question: Có tính NPV drip đầu tư từ một năm equal margin?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu future water price, scarcity, maintenance, life và discount; một năm không đủ.

assumptions: USD million, students. Fictional Tide Grove College. Toy choose annual intake with teaching-hour constraints, program C mandatory, divisible enrollment in planning. No impact on teaching quality assumed.

evidence.text: [Program A] Tuition $12k, direct variable cost $6k/student, 120 teaching hours/student; demand cap 300 students.
[Program B] Tuition $9k, variable cost $4k/student, 80 hours/student; cap 400.
[Program C] Tuition $7k, variable cost $5k/student, 100 hours/student; minimum 100, maximum 100. Community obligation requires full intake.
[Capacity] 60,000 teaching hours total. Common fixed campus cost 2m unchanged. No other capacity constraint.
[Alternative] Adjunct block adds 8,000 hours for .5m; capacity still subject to demand caps.
[Memo] Dean ranks A by absolute tuition, calls mandatory C a cash loss despite positive contribution; allocates full campus fixed to C.

qas.question: Contribution per teaching-hour của B?
Contribution per teaching-hour của A?
Sau mandatory C100 và B400, remaining teaching hours cho A?
Base optimal annual surplus after fixed cost?
Net incremental contribution adjunct block với divisible planning?
Có bỏ C100 để tối đa contribution?
qas.answer: Không. C mandatory. C itself contributes .2m before common costs; not a negative incremental contribution in isolation.

qas.question: Vì sao tuition 12k của A không phải quyết định optimal allocation?
qas.answer: Cần contribution sau direct cost và teaching hours; B tạo $62,5/h hơn A $50/h.

qas.question: Có khẳng định optimal finance allocation tối ưu chất lượng đào tạo?
qas.answer: Không. Toy không có student outcomes, class size effects hoặc social priorities ngoài C.

assumptions: USD million; thousand ore tonnes. Fictional Silver Reef Mine. Toy plant throughput scarce, compare current incremental contribution per ore tonne; mining costs already sunk, no recovery from unprocessed ore this year.

evidence.text: [Stockpile H] High-grade ore 200k tonnes, grade 3%, recovery 90%; payable metal price $6,000/t. Processing cost $80/ore tonne.
[Stockpile L] Low-grade ore 400k tonnes, grade 1.5%, recovery 80%; same metal price, processing cost $50/ore tonne.
[Plant] Capacity 450k ore tonnes. Ore divisible; no minimum blend or recovery interaction. Mining costs H $40/t, L $30/t incurred prior and sunk for this current dispatch comparison.
[Alternative] Toll plant can process remaining L up to 100k tonnes at $65/t, same recovery, no capacity interaction; fixed setup .5m if used.
[Policy] Current decision maximize incremental revenue less processing/setup cost. Inventory accounting carrying cost not in decision comparison.
[Memo] Engineer ranks stockpile by total previously incurred mining cost; proposes toll treatment because positive unit gross margin before setup.

qas.question: Metal revenue mỗi ore tonne H theo grade và recovery?
Incremental processing contribution mỗi ore tonne L nội bộ?
qas.answer: Ore L tạo .015×.8×6.000 = 72 USD doanh thu trên mỗi tấn quặng. Trừ processing50, contribution tăng thêm = 22 USD/tấn quặng.

qas.question: Optimal internal plant contribution trên capacity450k?
Toll 100k L net incremental benefit sau setup?
qas.answer: L tạo 72 USD/tấn doanh thu; toll cost65 nên contribution 7 USD/tấn. Với100 nghìn tấn, trừ setup0,5 triệu: 100×7/1.000−0,5 = 0,2 triệu USD.

qas.question: Toll setup break-even processed volume, nghìn tonnes?
qas.answer: Contribution mỗi tấn qua toll = .015×.8×6.000−65 = 7 USD. Break-even volume = 500.000/7 ≈ 71.428,57 tấn, tức 71,42857 nghìn tấn.

qas.question: Tại sao prior mining cost không đưa vào incremental choice?
qas.answer: Đã sunk cho cả stockpiles, không thay đổi dù xử lý hay không; accounting COGS có thể khác decision cash model.

qas.question: Có nên gọi low-grade L không kinh tế vì grade thấp hơn H?
qas.answer: Không. L internal margin $22/t dương, vẫn xử lý sau H tới capacity; grade alone không quyết định.

qas.question: Có tính lifetime mine cutoff grade từ current stockpiles?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu mining cost avoidable, geology, recovery by grade, future prices và capacity schedule.

assumptions: USD million, million m³. Fictional Ash Brook Water. Toy fix leakage to meet same billed demand with lower production; no incremental billed volume, savings retained only to extent tariff rule allows. Three-year factors supplied.

evidence.text: [Base] Produced 50m m³, billed 40m, physical leakage 10m. Production variable cost $.40/m³, tariff $1/m³. Fixed cost unchanged.
[Retrofit] Upfront 6m, reduces leakage by 6m m³ annually; billed demand remains 40m. Additional maintenance .3m/year. No other service benefit monetized.
[Tariff reset] Regulator reduces allowed tariff revenue by 50% of gross variable cost saving, effective immediately each year; maintenance cost not reimbursed.
[Grant] Upfront grant 1m approved, received immediately. Net initial outlay 5m.
[Valuation] Three annual year-end cash flows, annuity factor 2.486852 at 10%; no salvage, tax or other cash effects.
[Memo] Manager treats recovered leakage as extra billed sales of 6m and claims gross saving fully retained.

qas.question: Gross annual production cost savings từ giảm leakage?
Annual tariff revenue reduction theo regulator?
Net incremental annual owner cash flow after reset and maintenance?
NPV retrofit sau grant tại supplied factor?
Net upfront investment ceiling cho NPV zero theo annual flow?
Tại sao không cộng 6m extra sales vào forecast?
qas.answer: Billed demand giữ40m; giảm leakage giảm water production, không tăng số m³ bán trong case.

qas.question: Có khẳng định retrofit không đáng làm vì NPV âm?
qas.answer: Chỉ theo toy cash objective NPV âm; social value, reliability và compliance có thể khác nhưng không được lượng hóa.

qas.question: Có đo avoided water scarcity social benefit?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu scarcity valuation, environmental impacts và alternative supply costs.
